title: Claude Impact Lab × Cerebras Cafe Compute | Bhopal
hosts: Aniket Sahu, Arun Pratap Singh Chandel, Diyi Zhu · Claude Community Events
desc: Two days. Day 1 (4–7 PM): Cerebras workflow integration. Day 2 (9 AM–7:30 PM): a full Impact Lab where teams of 4–5 build on a real problem from a Madhya Pradesh government department with MPSeDC, using Claude, Claude Code and Cerebras inference.

title: Tally Meetup — Bhopal

desc: The first Tally meetup in Bhopal. A Tally 101 session, then a live form-build with Tally's AI assistant where you make your own form and share results. Chai, snacks, good conversations. Free, limited spots, no laptop needed.
